Sara Farnya <product@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Magda, Hope you are doing well too! I am happy to help with your queries: GPS Data Collection: This behavior is not typical, and it may have occurred due to the app being terminated in the background. I will ask the team to investigate this thoroughly to determine why GPS data has not been collected daily. I will get back to you once I have more information. Notification Preferences: Yes, we can definitely ask participants to choose their preferred method for receiving push notifications, whether through app notifications, email, or SMS. We can add a question to the "Baseline Survey" to ask participants how they would like to receive push notifications to complete the daily survey. Then, we could consider creating separate in-app, email, and SMS notification templates for the first reminder and set criteria for sending them based on participants' preferences. Please let me know if this sounds good, and I will take care of it. By the way, the addition of SMS notifications to your project is free of charge. However, service providers usually charge about CAD 0.02 per message, which we may need to consider for future phases if necessary. GPS Data Collection Details: You can read more about how GPS data is collected via the Avicenna app here. It would be beneficial to arrange a meeting with Amin and Faham to delve deeper into this topic. During the meeting, we will provide a detailed explanation of the entire process. Our calendar is shared here, feel free to choose a time that is most convenient for you. Looking forward to speaking with you.Best, Sara On Tuesday, September 10, 2024 at 1:22:06 AM,

Hi Magda,I hope you’re having a great weekend.Our team has thoroughly investigated the GPS Data Collection issue you mentioned and confirmed that the device is killing the app in the background, preventing it from starting up again. To resolve this, please follow one of these methods:1. Go to Phone Manager > App Startup Management > Disable Automatic Management > Allow Auto Startup or Allow Background Activities. 2. Alternatively, swipe down to access Quick Settings, enter the Settings on your phone, search for "App Launch," open it, disable the switch for the Avicenna app, and in the Manage Manually pop-up window that appears, enable Auto-launch and Run in the Background.After making these changes, please reload the studies. On another note, let me know if you would like to proceed with asking participants to choose their preferred method for receiving push notifications. If you have any questions in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out. Our calendar is shared here just in case. Best,Sara On Wednesday, September 11, 2024 at 2:36:06 AM,
